verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover every step of the story. The Checkouts API creates a single-use checkout that returns a payment URL (docs-33) and includes settlement details (docs-9). Payment acceptance supports USDC/USDT with auth, capture and void (docs-4, docs-11, docs-21, docs-39), deposit-destination addresses auto-credit an account (docs-22), and webhooks give real-time, at-least-once HTTP notifications (docs-15, docs-59). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation of checkout or payment-specific webhook events for confirming settlement.
